verdict.rationale: Reflect does ship its own OAuth2 REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, but it covers only a narrow slice of the UI. The documented endpoints are listing graphs, getting and creating links, appending to daily notes, creating notes, and reading the current user. The docs themselves say end-to-end encryption means the API cannot serve note contents, so reading, searching, editing, AI, history, publishing and similar UI features are unavailable programmatically. missing for 10: reading or retrieving note contents via API, editing or updating notes, search/filter endpoints, AI/chat endpoints, note history and revert, publishing, tags/backlinks access, any statement of UI–API parity, versioning policy.
